## 0.5.11

- Cleanup removes a stray “Mm-hmm” after a complete English dictation.
- Full cleanup keeps your words when a rewrite drops a name or cuts a large part of your dictation.
- Dicta keeps the GPU speech model ready between dictations. It frees the helper after two idle minutes if Windows is still running short of RAM or room to commit more memory.
- Meeting transcription checks for speech before decoding audio, so clicks, typing and hum are less likely to turn into words in transcripts or summaries.
